5231-6972-7841.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

628-6495-7212.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7212.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1742-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2617-4200-7150.easyPrerequisites: Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
2617-4200-7150.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Icewind Stalwart's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Icewind Stalwart's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2348-4019-5175--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Caged Sun triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-4019-5175--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1008-1619-4605-5147-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5147-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5147-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

292-4968-7704.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-7704.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

413-3112-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
When Slurrk enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-4067-7419.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-4067-7419.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast a copy of Ancestral Recall by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Ideation. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Ancestral Recall, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
1170-4067-7419.notes: As long as you have cards in your hand, you can target other players with Ancestral Recall as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-6961-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-6961-7422.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2

891-1703-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

628-5231-7197.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2781-3817-4050.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-3703-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3703-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1978-2392-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
1978-2392-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat

413-4338-5929.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

215-4010-6723-6791.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-6791.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2018-2511-3216.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

198-3767-3918-5929.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-3767-3918-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
198-3767-3918-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
198-3767-3918-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3542-5140-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
3542-5140-5231.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1170-1636-3540.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{B}{B}.
1170-1636-3540.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Mourning by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mourning spell.
Activate Mourning by paying {B}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

311-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coral Trickster, adding {U}.
When Coral Trickster dies, Yedora triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Coral Trickster by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, tapping or untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

1669-4618-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {2}.
 Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
1669-4618-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Instill Energy attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Instill Energy token by paying {0}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing the Instill Energy token, causing Thaumatog to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2622-3609-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Jinxed Choker's ability three times by paying {9}, putting three charge counters on it.
Activate Trazyn using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
